channel.description: Latest articles from The Old House Life (theoldhouselife.com)

item.title: Pretty details inside! Circa 1911 in North Carolina. $339,900
item.description: This house has pretty details inside! There is a bit of maximalism going on. The house isn’t far from Childress Vineyards. The house was built in 1911. It is located on .19 acre in Lexington, North Carolina. The house features a unique front walkway, a covered front porch, stained glass, wood floors, french doors, crown moulding, crystal chandeliers, wide baseboards, wainscoting, updated kitchen and a laundry room. There is a large back deck and a detached garage. Four bedrooms, three bathrooms

item.title: Nicely maintained interior! Circa 1881 in North Carolina. $178,000
item.description: This house looks like it has been maintained quite nicely! Some rooms feel a bit dark, but paint and lighting would help. The house was built in 1881. It is located on .24 acre in North Wilkesboro, North Carolina. The house features a covered front porch, wood floors, bead board wainscoting, crown moulding, spacious kitchen and updated bathrooms. There is a fenced in backyard. One bedroom, two bathrooms and 1,566 square feet. $178,000 Contact Mike Martinez with North Carolina Mountain Investment

item.title: Cute house! Circa 1929 in Oklahoma. $184,500
item.description: This is a cute house! I like the porch! The house was built in 1929. It is located in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma. The house features a covered front porch, wood floors, barrel vaulted ceiling, baseboards, unique fireplace, updated bathroom, telephone nook and a lot of natural light. There is a nice backyard with a deck and a detached garage. Two bedrooms, one bathroom and 1,121 square feet. $184,500 Contact Josh Jewell with Stonehenge Properties: 405-408-0761 From the Zillow listing: Charming 2-Bed

item.title: Colorful! Pretty interior! Circa 1896 in Oregon. $452,288
item.description: This house has a colorful exterior! There are pretty details inside! The house was built in 1896. It is located in Astoria, Oregon. The house features a small covered front porch, wood floors, chandeliers with ceiling medallions, stained glass windows, spacious kitchen, large finished basement and french doors. The home is situated in the vibrant Uniontown neighborhood. Two bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,036 square feet. $452,288 Contact Darlene Van Auken with Coastal Advantage: 503-791-5770 From

item.title: Lodge on 15 acres in Pennsylvania. Has an orchard. $219,900
item.description: This would be fun to own! Nice acreage and there is an orchard on the property! The lodge was built in 1905. It is located on 15.45 acres in Ulysses, Pennsylvania. The lodge definitely needs work, but I kind of like the rustic feel of it. There is a large covered porch, bead board and shake siding. There is a large post and beam building that was originally used for maple syrup production. Seven bedrooms, three bathrooms and 2,022 square feet. $219,900 Contact Russell James Bull with Mountain Va

item.title: Missouri’s most expensive old house listing! Stunning! C. 1878. $4,800,000
item.description: Welcome to Missouri’s most expensive old house listing! This is absolutely stunning! Green with envy over all of their amazing portraits! That barn is pretty special too! The Henry Blosser Estate features a main house that was built in 1878. It is listed on the National Register of Historic Places. The property features a large barn and a ADA compliant guest cottage. Seven bedrooms, ten bathrooms and 7,,775 square feet. $4,800,000 From the Zillow listing: The National Register of Historic Places

item.title: Don’t judge a book by its cover! This has character! C. 1910 in North Carolina. $240,000
item.description: Don’t judge a book by it’s cover! Sure wasn’t expecting that interior to have that much character! The house was built in 1910. It is located on .33 acre in Burlington, North Carolina. The house features a pretty sunroom, wood floors, crown moulding, wide baseboards, french doors, wainscoting, ceiling medallion, great kitchen stove and how about that den! New HVAC and updated electric. Two bedrooms, three bathrooms and 1,620 square feet. $240,000 Contact Sarah R. Kindley with Coldwell Banker Adv

item.title: Love this! Circa 1829! Ten riverfront acres in Virginia. $575,000
item.description: I love this house and property! That brickwork is pretty cool! River looks pretty! The house was built in 1829. It is located on 10.48 acres in Rockbridge Baths, Virginia. The house features a small covered front porch, covered side porch, pretty staircase scrollwork, wood floors, paneled wainscoting, wide baseboards, beautiful federal mantel and chair rails. There are a few outbuildings on the property. The land is in a conservation easement. Four bedrooms, three bathrooms and 2,680 square feet

item.title: Potential! J. J. McClure House, Circa 1848. Almost one acre in South Carolina. $219,000
item.description: This house has a lot of potential! It was built for the first mayor of the town. The J. J. McClure house was built in 1848. It is located on .93 acre in Chester, South Carolina. The J. J. McClure House features a covered porch, balcony, wood floors, baseboards, crown moulding and chair rails. This house needs a floor plan included. The backyard has a large patio. Four bedrooms, four bathrooms and 3,300 square feet. $219,000 Contact the property owner: 803-379-1809 From the Zillow listing: This m

item.title: Pretty interior! Unpainted woodwork! Circa 1912 in Tennessee. $229,900
item.description: This house has a pretty interior! Love the unpainted woodwork and the ceiling medallions! The historic Hightower Craig House was built in 1912. It is located on .51 acre in Ripley, Tennessee. The house features a covered front porch, a porte cochere, wood floors, crown moulding, baseboards, pocket doors, bay windows, built-in china cabinet, chair rails, ceiling medallions, vintage light fixtures and a spacious kitchen. Four bedrooms, three bathrooms and 3,652 square feet. $229,900 Contact Leigh
